visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied in buns, wearing a cream-colored ribbed sweater, sits on a couch in a brightly lit living room. She holds a large Dior gift box and gestures with her hands. (2) Close-up shot of the interior of the white gift box, filled with shredded paper, black Dior fragrance boxes (Sauvage), and silver compacts. (3) A promotional image of Jisoo from BLACKPINK for Dior appears, followed by high-quality product photos of several Dior luminizer compacts in different shades. (4) The scene shifts to a mobile screen recording of the Dior official website, showing the 'Forever Glow Luminizer' selection interface with various color swatches. (5) Back to the woman, she holds two blue Dior luminizer boxes and a large Sauvage bottle, then displays the gift box again as sparkly animations overlay the screen. (6) She holds a pink quilted Dior cosmetic pouch, feeling its texture with her fingers, then opens it to reveal small samples of lip gloss and mascara. (7) Another screen recording shows a list of sample choices available for purchases over 3,600 dollars, followed by her showing a 10ml Sauvage sample next to the full-size bottle. (8) She displays a white Dior-branded drawstring dust bag, pulling the ribbons to show how it closes. (9) The woman holds a sleek black 'Dior Homme' branded coffee tumbler, rotating it to show the logo and the lid, appearing very impressed. (10) Close-up of the Sauvage perfume bottle with a custom engraving that says 'August,' while she points to the engraving with her finger. (11) Final sequence showing her holding a silver Dior compact, opening it to reveal the powder inside, followed by a pink outro screen with a photo of her wearing glasses.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator; 1 female model (Jisoo) appearing in a static advertisement photo.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with reddish-brown hair styled in two low buns with side-swept bangs. She is wearing a white/cream knit sweater and subtle makeup with glitter near the eyes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A comfortable indoor living room with a beige sofa, a patterned pillow (Hermès-style), and warm curtains. Some parts of the video are digital screen recordings of a website and static graphic backgrounds with pink patterns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal female greeting in Mandarin, accompanied by a bright, upbeat electronic pop track with a steady drum machine beat. (2) A clear 'Ding' SFX occurs at 0:02 as the gift box is shown. (3) A sharp 'Whoosh' sound effect triggers a phase change at 0:09 during the transition to the advertising image. (4) At 0:25, multiple 'Pop' and 'Sparkle' sound effects coincide with the visual of the full gift box. (5) Audible rustling of plastic and paper occurs at 0:35 as the creator handles the cosmetic pouch, while the BGM remains constant. (6) A distinct 'Impact' or digital notification sound effect marks the start of the tumbler presentation at 0:59. (7) High-pitched 'Sparkle' SFX repeat at 0:121 to emphasize the engraving on the perfume bottle. (8) The video concludes with the creator's voice fading out and the music ending with a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Itemized Review of Purchases -> Detailed List of Gifts/Samples -> Tutorial on How to Get Perks -> Closing/Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a massive unboxing of Dior products purchased from the official website, specifically highlighting the high volume and quality of free gifts (pouches, tumblers, samples) received to motivate viewers to shop through the same channel.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed explanation of shopping thresholds (e.g., $5,800, $3,600), display of official website interface, and explicit instructions to buy from the official site for free perks.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density editing typical of short-form social media vlogs, using frequent text overlays and SFX to maintain engagement. The contrast between purchased items and free gifts is the primary narrative hook.
